mapper.select: select s.*, c.name as categoryName from setmeal s left join category c on s.category_id = c.id and c.tenant_id = s.tenant_id where s.id = #{id} and s.tenant_id = #{scopeTenant}

update setmeal
name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, image = #{image}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser},
where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{scopeTenant} and exists (select 1 from category c where c.id = #{categoryId} and c.tenant_id = #{scopeTenant})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.image, COALESCE(m.override_price, p.price) AS price FROM setmeal p JOIN store_setmeal m ON m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND m.setmeal_id = p.id JOIN store s ON s.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND s.id = m.store_id JOIN tenant t ON t.id = s.tenant_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND s.id = #{store} AND t.status = 1 AND s.status = 1 AND p.status = 1 AND m.on_sale = 1 AND m.sold_out = 0
